Recommended Bagels. Mediocre service only.
Jul 2020
It's been quite a while since I last patronised Saigon Bagels. My first and only visit was to their then, one and only shop downtown in District 1, Vo Van Kiet Road and my thoughts were that the food was just acceptable and that the restaurant settings were more cafe like, no aircon, windows opened to a noisy and dusty main thoroughfare.

All that seems to have changed with this new outlet in D2. It's located in a kind of quiet street, visibility is so low that you might have a tough time locating this place.

I was here for breakfast. As I walked in, the staff ignored me even though she wasn't doing anything. Not a good way to boost business, especially when I subsequently discovered I was the only customer in the shop from 9am to 11am on a Friday morning. NOT A GOOD WAY TO START!!!

I ordered a Ca Phe da and a Gravalax on sesame bagel, plus avocado on the side. Food and drinks were served in double quick time, about 5 minutes. Portion size was extremely generous, and food was well presented (see photos). I would rate the test as an 8.5 out of 10.0 which means it isn't bad at all. 

However, the avocado was NOT SERVED ON THE SIDE as ordered. I pointed this out to the waitress who merely mumbled and smiled at me. Again, not good here as far as service is concerned.

Another point of great concern.......Vietnam is a leading country in combating drinking straw pollution. All the other cafes that I patronise for breakfast now serve their drinks using either paper, rush or stainless steel straws. Yet, Saigon Bagel still retains the use of single-use plastic straws. If I feel strongly about making a statement about this, I would probably not return until this changes.

So, in conclusion Saigon Bagel need to train or supervise their staff a whole lot better before they start losing customers and recommendations.

Great Breakfast Bagels, Coffee is also quite good.
Dec 2019
I have always liked Saigon Bagel and am just now writing a review. This restaurant is in District 2, down a small side street. For the price their break bagels are really good, make sure to ask them for it toasted. Also the drip coffee is what I prefer, sometimes it is hard to find. The restaurant has limited seating, unsure if it has a second floor. Outside is best, with the nice climbing vines on the walls. I think that the bagels are some of the best in Vietnam, however they don't quite remind me of home (NY style) they are still absolutely worth the time. I try to go here once a month.
